projects.name: Caladan
projects.baselines: Linux kernel networking (epoll), Shenango, IX, Arachne, Parties
projects.lead: Shenango's maintained successor (OSDI '20, 'Caladan: Mitigating Interference at Microsecond Timescales'); the paper claims up to 11,000x lower tail latency than Parties under interference. The Shenango enricher notes it adds directpath and TCP window scaling. Report the paper's comparisons against Linux and Shenango honestly, with hardware and setup.

projects.name: Machnet
projects.baselines: Linux kernel TCP/UDP sockets, eRPC, gRPC
projects.lead: The eRPC authors point new users to Machnet (DPDK-based messaging for cloud VMs). Look for its published latency/throughput numbers against the Linux kernel stack (README, docs, NSDI/arXiv paper) and state hardware, VM type and flags.
